text: Server: PATCH /settings behaves as PUT — currency-only PATCH wipes the initials override

Groomed 2026-07-16, implementation hint: routes/account.py should distinguish absent-vs-present keys from the raw dict ("default_currency" in data / "initials" in data) and pass an explicit sentinel (e.g. module-level _UNSET) or per-field flags into accounts.update_settings — present-and-null initials means "clear override" (write NULL), absent means "leave unchanged"; absent currency skips the currency write+validation entirely. Validate types of present values (non-str initials currently 500s on len()). Keep returning the full resolved settings body. Client workarounds (web SettingsPage, Android SettingsViewModel "must resend" comments) can then be simplified in the same ticket or left harmless — implementer choice, but update the comments if left.
